function.name: PelvicFracturePlanning
function.description: Guided interactive workflow for PelvicFracturePlanning. Execute steps in order. Interactive steps require user 3D interaction. Steps: 'cb_step_1': In the "Input CT Volume" option, choose the Pelvic Volume.; 'cb_step_2': Click "Run Step 1: Segment Pelvis" button.; 'cb_step_3': For the 3D view, click the "Center view" botton.; 'cb_step_4': Click "Run Step 2: Segment Fractures" button.; 'cb_step_5': In the "Untick a piece to stop treating it as separate" section, untick these segments.; 'cb_step_6': If a piece should have been split but was and and require cut it manually, jump to step 7. If not, jump to step 10.; 'cb_step_7': Click "Manually seperate" button.; 'cb_step_8': Manually click to add a cut point and adjust the position and rotation of the cutting plane. (interactive: plane); 'cb_step_9': Click "Confirm seperation" button.; 'cb_step_10': Click "Run Step 3: Generate template" button.

user_action.description: Action: 'start' to begin a step, 'proceed' after user completes interaction, 'skip' for optional steps, 'cancel' to abort workflow, 'choice_made' for user_choice steps

choice_value.description: Value selected by the user for user_choice steps. Required when user_action is 'choice_made'. A multi-selection step takes a JSON object mapping each parameter_name to its value.
